question: What covering lies above the fixed covering and who dwells there?
premises: Above the fixed covering is the covering of will.
There those Shivas dwell within the house of the Lord's will.
Its city is said to be one.
inference: The covering of will contains Shivas associated with the Lord's will and has a single city.
plain_english: Above the fixed covering is the covering of will. There dwell those Shivas within the house of the Lord's will, and its city is said to be one.
